name: Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity / Hitting Size (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For half-intervals $\mathcal I_n$, $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{peq}}(\mathcal I_n)=\log n$ while $\mathrm{HT}(\mathcal I_n)=1$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For singletons plus the empty set $\mathcal S_n\cup\{\emptyset\}$, $\mathrm{HT}=n$ while $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{peq}}=1$.
proof: The Half-interval and Singletons-plus-empty-set value calculations give the two opposite unbounded separations.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity and Hitting Size of Half-intervals and Singletons plus the Empty Set.
